profile.headline: Frontend Software Developer | Software Engineer | Avid Learner | Human Being
profile.summary:
I am a Frontend Developer, who enjoys problem solving, learning and collaboration. My previous work experience includes customer service and IT as a Linux Systems Administrator. Working in various industries, as well as completing education at Metropolitan State University of Denver, and Turing School of Software & Design, has prepared me for tackling new challenges.

I look forward to working with a team in which I can be my authentic self, do enjoyable work and contribute to solutions which will help others. If you are interested in discussing opportunities within your organization, or would simply like to network, let's connect!

Skills:
React | Next.js | TypeScript | TailWindCSS | JavaScript | CSS3 | HTML5 | Node.js | Express.js | Knex | Cypress | Mocha | Chai |  Git | GitHub | Postman | Vercel | Heroku | CircleCI | Miro | Figma | GraphQL | Heroku | Docker | Linux | Retool

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Collaborated with a team of engineers, designers, and project managers to develop a social media presence application using agile methodologies.

Designed and implemented an engaging front-end user experience, enabling users to manage various aspects of their social media by integrating with their existing accounts.

Continuously improved React application performance through code reviews, feedback, and refactoring.

Participated in product meetings and project demonstrations to ensure alignment with project scope and value.

Translated high-quality designs into compelling user interfaces.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · React.js · TypeScript · Node.js · Functional Programming · vite · Git · GitHub · GitHub Copilot · Miro Collaboration Platform · Figma (Software) · Confluence · Trello · Tailwind CSS

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Participated in two cohorts of makeItMVP Launch Academy, a six-week program which builds skills through practical, project-building experience. This opportunity allows for transforming concepts into Minimum Viable Products via collaboration, innovation, and complex problem solving.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Firebase · GitHub · Front-End Development · Cross-team Collaboration · SASS

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Initiated active participation and contribution from the onset of the internship.

Engaged in four sprints over a three-month period, ensuring alignment with project timelines and goals.

Developed an internally facing (Retool) application tailored for the Sales Team, facilitating efficient information display.

Conducted independent research to gather information and proactively solve complex problems.

Collaborated with team members through pair programming, fostering effective teamwork.

Responded to peer reviews and feedback by refactoring JavaScript code for continuous improvement.

Actively participated in manual QA testing, covering user flows, bugfix verification, and other critical aspects.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Linear · Retool · Software Development · GitHub · React.js · TypeScript · GraphQL

positions.title: Career transition
positions.description:
Took time to do a career reassessment, which led to pursuing Software Engineering

Earned a Front End Engineering Certificate from Turing School of Software & Design

Completed over 15 projects, both solo and group based

positions.title: Network and Systems Administrator
positions.description: Successfully maintained and monitored highly complex decentralized blockchain applications in dynamic cloud environments, ensuring optimal performance and uninterrupted availability.

positions.title: Server Administrator
positions.description: Demonstrated exceptional proficiency in administering server life-cycles across multiple co-locations, while simultaneously enhancing and optimizing existing technical infrastructure to maximize efficiency and improve overall system performance.

positions.title: System Administrator
positions.description:
Implemented robust security protocols and conducted regular maintenance on critical IT infrastructure to ensure optimal performance, maintain data integrity and safeguard against potential threats

Conducted in-depth analysis and evaluation of emerging IT solutions, leveraging cutting-edge tools and techniques to develop and deploy innovative solutions that met complex business requirements and enhanced organizational effectiveness.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer and Information Systems Security/Information Assurance

projects.description: This web application was created in order to learn a new JavaScript Framework (Vue), while creating a game that would be fun and relaxing to play.

projects.title: Mock Grocery Store App
projects.description: This web application was created for a week-long take home challenge. It allowed me to utilize skills learned in my bootcamp experience, and beyond, to craft a solution that is engaging and fun!
